description: This file defines a PHP class Map within the Opencart framework, specifically in the admin dashboard extension. The class provides a method to retrieve total orders grouped by country, filtering by completed order statuses.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving aggregate order data by country within the Opencart admin dashboard.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Fetches and returns an array of total order count and sum of totals grouped by country, filtered by complete order statuses.
